title: Sereja and Prefixes
statementMd:
Sereja loves number sequences very much. That's why he decided to make himself a new one following a certain algorithm.

Sereja takes a blank piece of paper. Then he starts writing out the sequence in $*m*$ stages. Each time he either adds a new number to the end of the sequence or takes $*l*$ first elements of the current sequence and adds them $*c*$ times to the end. More formally, if we represent the current sequence as $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$, then after we apply the described operation, the sequence transforms into $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}[, *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l*}]$ (the block in the square brackets must be repeated $*c*$ times).

A day has passed and Sereja has completed the sequence. He wonders what are the values of some of its elements. Help Sereja.

## Input

The first line contains integer $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of stages to build a sequence.

Next $*m*$ lines contain the description of the stages in the order they follow. The first number in the line is a type of stage (1 or 2). Type 1 means adding one number to the end of the sequence, in this case the line contains integer $*x*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number to add. Type 2 means copying a prefix of length $*l*_{*i*}$ to the end $*c*_{*i*}$ times, in this case the line further contains two integers $*l*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4})$, $*l*_{*i*}$ is the length of the prefix, $*c*_{*i*}$ is the number of copyings. It is guaranteed that the length of prefix $*l*_{*i*}$ is never larger than the current length of the sequence.

The next line contains integer $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$ — the number of elements Sereja is interested in. The next line contains the numbers of elements of the final sequence Sereja is interested in. The numbers are given in the strictly increasing order. It is guaranteed that all numbers are strictly larger than zero and do not exceed the length of the resulting sequence. Consider the elements of the final sequence numbered starting from $1$ from the beginning to the end of the sequence.

Please, do not use the `%lld` specifier to read or write 64-bit integers in С++. It is preferred to use the `cin`, `cout` streams or the `%I64d` specifier.

## Output

Print the elements that Sereja is interested in, in the order in which their numbers occur in the input.
statementZhMd:
Sereja 非常喜欢数字序列。因此，他决定按照某种算法构造一个新的数字序列。

Sereja 拿出一张空白纸。随后，他分 $*m*$ 个阶段逐步写出这个序列。每次操作中，他要么在序列末尾添加一个新数字，要么取出当前序列的前 $*l*$ 个元素，并将它们重复添加到序列末尾 $*c*$ 次。更形式化地说，如果当前序列表示为 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$，那么执行上述操作后，序列将变为 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}[, *a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*l*}]$（方括号中的部分必须重复 $*c*$ 次）。

一天过去了，Sereja 已经完成了这个序列。他想知道其中某些元素的值。请帮助 Sereja。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{5})$——构造序列的阶段数。

接下来 $*m*$ 行按照阶段执行的顺序描述各个阶段。每行的第一个数字表示阶段类型（1 或 2）。类型 1 表示在序列末尾添加一个数字，此时该行还包含一个整数 $*x*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5})$——要添加的数字。类型 2 表示将长度为 $*l*_{*i*}$ 的前缀复制到序列末尾 $*c*_{*i*}$ 次，此时该行还包含两个整数 $*l*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}$ $(1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}, 1 ≤ *c*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{4})$，其中 $*l*_{*i*}$ 是前缀长度，$*c*_{*i*}$ 是复制次数。保证前缀长度 $*l*_{*i*}$ 不会大于当前序列的长度。

下一行包含一个整数 $*n*$ $(1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5})$——Sereja 感兴趣的元素个数。下一行包含最终序列中 Sereja 感兴趣的元素的编号。这些编号按严格递增顺序给出。保证所有编号均严格大于零，且不超过最终序列的长度。将最终序列中的元素从序列开头到末尾编号为 1 开始的连续整数。

请不要在 C++ 中使用 `%lld` 格式说明符读写 64 位整数。建议使用 `cin`、`cout` 流或 `%I64d` 格式说明符。

## 输出格式

按照输入中给出的编号顺序，输出 Sereja 感兴趣的元素。
